trigger: RESTORED_HOLD after successful D5 single-channel replacement
sequence: discard all pre-loss/pre-replacement receipts for the affected epoch
regenerate the six A4 module-interface receipt bits from a fresh post-replacement frame
check the native K4 cut-space [6,3,3] receipt code
regenerate the 12 S4/octahedron comparison receipt bits
check the octahedron cut-space [12,5,4] receipt code
only if both receipt syndromes are zero transition to RETRY_READY; otherwise remain HOLD_RECEIPT
start a fresh 2+PV attempt from RETRY_READY

receipt_error_model.p6: iid flip probability on each of the 6 fresh K4 interface receipt bits
receipt_error_model.p12: iid flip probability on each of the 12 fresh S4 comparison receipt bits
receipt_error_model.independence: the two receipt layers are independent only for the frozen analytic benchmark

combined_retry_gate.typed_note: these are subsets of RESTORED_HOLD; fresh 2+PV begins only from RETRY_READY_SAFE/UNSAFE_POSSIBLE distinction in the analytic model

acceptance_scope: native K4 layer detects every receipt-bit error of weight 1 or 2
S4 overlay detects every comparison-bit error of weight 1, 2 or 3
neither layer corrects receipt bits in this protocol; nonzero syndrome causes HOLD
claim_rule: This is independent receipt verification of a restored channel configuration, not additional quantum-code distance.
